label: Jun 2, 2026
headline: USTravelDocs & CEAC hit by outages — scheduling and payments disrupted
summary: US visa processing websites including USTravelDocs.com and CEAC are experiencing significant technical issues, delaying interview bookings, fee payments, and document uploads. India is among the hardest-hit countries. State Dept working on fix, no timeline given. Applicants advised to retry after 24 hours.

label: May 30, 2026
headline: DHS walks back Green Card return-home rule — now case-by-case
summary: After backlash to the May 23 directive, DHS clarifies most green card applicants will NOT be required to leave the US. Adjustment of status called 'extraordinary relief' but officers decide case-by-case — no blanket exit mandate.

label: May 27, 2026
headline: EB-2 India green card quota fully exhausted for FY2026
summary: All EB-2 immigrant visa numbers for India used up. Final Action Date retrogressed to Sep 2013. No new EB-2 green cards for Indians until FY2027 begins Oct 2026.

label: May 26, 2026
headline: Rubio freezes student visa appointments worldwide
summary: US State Department halts all new F-1 visa appointments. Indian fall enrollments already in freefall.

label: May 24, 2026
headline: Rubio launches "AppUS" — new America First visa scheduling tool
summary: Prioritises business professionals who strengthen US-India commercial ties. Announced during Rubio's first India visit as Secretary of State.

label: May 23, 2026
headline: Green Card applicants must return to home country to apply
summary: US government announces that those seeking a Green Card must now return to their home countries to file — a major shift affecting thousands of Indian applicants. (Update: DHS partially walked this back on May 30.)

headline: Kolkata launches priority B1/B2 slots for parents 50+
summary: US Consulate Kolkata now offers priority visitor visa appointments for eligible Indian parents aged 50 and above visiting children in the US.

label: Dec 2025
headline: Social media screening expanded to employment visas
summary: Adds ~30 min per case, slashing daily appointment capacity by nearly half. Backlogs expected through Q2 2026.

label: Sep 2025
headline: Interview waiver eliminated for work & student visas
summary: H-1B, H-4, L-1, F-1, J-1, O-1 applicants no longer qualify for interview waiver. All must attend in-person interviews.
